OUR ROOTS. OUR PEOPLE. OUR PURPOSE.

Built around
our community.

Finrel began with a simple ambition: to bring healthcare and everyday shopping closer to the people who need them.

That commitment still shapes the way we welcome you today.

FROM ONE SHOP TO YOUR NEIGHBOURHOOD

A story of
growing together.

2014

The beginning

Finrel Nigeria Limited was incorporated to operate in healthcare and retail.

2015

Our first doors opened

On 1 August, we welcomed our first customers to our pharmacy and supermarket at Ojurin Akobo, Ibadan.

Since then

More ways to serve

Finrel expanded its branch network and added veterinary care and in-store bakeries. Signature ice cream and yoghurt also became part of the company’s story.

OUR VISION

“To be number one in every community we serve.”

OUR MISSION

To take retail business to everywhere there is a need, providing the community with the best prices and best services that exceed customer expectations.
